text: ADNOC (Abu Dhabi National Oil Company) owns 24.9% of the shares of OMV Aktiengesellschaft.

source.name: OMV: Shareholder structure (omv.com)
source.quote: 24.9% Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) P.J.S.C.
source.note: Undated investor page listing OMV's shareholder base (the '1' is a footnote marker). A note on the page says ADNOC has announced its intention to transfer the 24.9% stake to XRG P.J.S.C., its wholly-owned investment company, subject to regulatory approvals. Date is the day the page was opened.

additionalSources.name: ADNOC press release: ADNOC Closes Acquisition of 24.9% Stake in OMV
additionalSources.quote: Following the successful completion of the transaction, ADNOC owns 24.9% of OMV
additionalSources.note: ADNOC's announcement of the closing of the purchase of Mubadala's 24.9% stake in OMV, completed 28 February 2024.
